answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded escrow and aggregates evidence of correlated equivocation. If k coordinated identities sign conflicting histories, pairwise accountability yields penalties scaling as O(k²), not merely one isolated fine per signer. On detection, the swarm’s exposed capital can also incur a configured exponential multiplier, such as m^k for m > 1, with asymmetric depreciation increasing losses on slashed bonds. The cipher verifies proofs; orchard and mesa label separate validator domains, not exemptions.
